# MarketToSkills — LLM Agent Registry Manifest

> Generated: 2026-09-15T17:38:33.859136 | Skills Count: 1506

## API Endpoints for Autonomous Agents
- GET /api/skills — Returns full JSON array of all active skills
- GET /api/categories — Returns categories with live count
- GET /api/agent/install?skills=id1,id2 — Download concatenated installation bundle
